content.value: In a residential area of 250,000inhabitants, the specific water demand is (10) estimated as 200 l/c/d, which includes leakage. Calculate the demand in 20 years' time if the assumed annual demand growth is 2.86%. Compare the results by applying the linear and exponential models.
